question: By whom is this path of the Kula scripture properly revealed?
premises: A specific path is identified as belonging to the Kula scripture.
The path is said to be well shown.
The guru is named as the agent of showing.
inference: This path of the Kula scripture is well shown by the guru.
uncertainties: The fused token tvamārgoyaṃ contains internal sandhi; analyzed as a single surface unit.
plain_english: This path of the Kula scripture has been well shown by the guru.
